task_instruction: Rewrite each affirmative statement as a negative question.
paragraphs: Nora and her brother Liam arrived at a ski resort early on Saturday. {{red:The beginner slopes are open.}} {{mask_1}}? They check the trail map before choosing where to start. {{red:Nora has visited this resort before.}} {{mask_2}}? She recognizes the lodge near the main lift.

At the rental desk, Liam asks for a snowboard. {{red:He has brought his own helmet.}} {{mask_3}}? The staff member checks the fit before he goes outside. {{red:The boots are comfortable.}} {{mask_4}}? Liam walks across the room to test them. {{red:Nora does a short warm-up before skiing.}} {{mask_5}}? She stretches beside the trail sign.

Their instructor meets them at the practice area. {{red:She is waiting near the blue flag.}} {{mask_6}}? Nora waves when she sees her. {{red:The instructor has explained the safety rules.}} {{mask_7}}? She asks Liam to point out the closest marked trail. {{red:Liam understands the signs.}} {{mask_8}}? He identifies the green and blue symbols correctly.

During the first lesson, {{red:Nora is keeping her skis parallel.}} {{mask_9}}? The instructor shows her how to turn slowly. {{red:Liam is listening to the instructor.}} {{mask_10}}? He asks a question about stopping on a gentle slope. {{red:The instructor demonstrates the stopping position.}} {{mask_11}}? Liam practices it several times.

At midday, the siblings take a break in the lodge. {{red:They have eaten lunch already.}} {{mask_12}}? Nora checks the trail map again. {{red:Liam has had enough water.}} {{mask_13}}? He fills his bottle before they leave. {{red:The weather is changing quickly.}} {{mask_14}}? Dark clouds are moving over the higher slopes.

They return their rental equipment in the afternoon. {{red:Nora has enjoyed her first lesson.}} {{mask_15}}? She thanks the instructor before they say goodbye. {{red:Liam does want to try snowboarding again.}} {{mask_16}}? He tells Nora that he plans to book another lesson. {{red:The resort staff were helpful all day.}} {{mask_17}}? The family thanks them at the desk.

Before they leave, Nora checks the bus time. {{red:The next bus is arriving in ten minutes.}} {{mask_18}}? Liam carries their helmets to the stop. {{red:They have packed their gloves.}} {{mask_19}}? Nora looks inside the gear bag. {{red:The siblings are tired after their day outside.}} {{mask_20}}? They sit together and talk about what they learned.
